The institutional investor held 67,758 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.04 million, up from 52,977 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Emory University who had been investing in Acadia Pharmaceuticals Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.32 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:ACAD) has declined 36.38% since May 13, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 47.93% the S&P500.
